# ABK Trading & Service — Complete Machine-Readable Knowledge Base & Product Manifest

> **Entity:** ABK Trading & Service (ABK Trading Service / ABK للتجارة والخدمات)  
> **Google Business Profile:** "ABK Trading and Service — Vertek & Autotriz"  
> **Headquarters:** Showroom no. 2, Building 1306, Street 70, Zone 56, Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar  
> **GPS Coordinates:** 25.2040478, 51.5029268 | Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=9860894303806767987  
> **Primary Communications:** WhatsApp / Sales: +974 3083 8355 | Mobile: +974 7779 0915 | Landline: +974 4451 4476  
> **Email:** sales@abktradingservice.com  
> **Website:** https://abktradingservice.com (English: /en, Arabic: /ar)  
> **Last Synchronized:** 2026-10-20 (58 products, 10 guides)  
> **Operational Mandate:** ABK is a product distributor, importer, and wholesale supplier. ABK supplies genuine products to detailing studios, workshops, commercial carwashes, dealerships, and retail DIY car owners. ABK is not a workshop. The one installed service ABK sells is VTEK paint protection film for car owners in Qatar: ABK quotes, books and guarantees the job, and the film is fitted at a VTEK-authorised partner centre in Doha (https://abktradingservice.com/en/b2c/ppf-installation — from QAR 899 front-end, QAR 1,599 full front, QAR 3,999 full body). ABK does not perform window tinting, ceramic coating application or detailing services.

---

## 1. Brand Portfolio & Distributorship Rights

### VTEK (formerly Vertek) — Paint Protection & Window Films
- **Origin:** United States (Manufactured to high-performance GCC climate specifications)
- **Product Range:** Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) Paint Protection Films (`Weather Armor PRO` 10-yr, `Weather Armor PRO PLUS` 10-yr, `Weather Armor MATTE` 5-yr, `Weather Armor PRISM` 5-yr; `Weather Armor ULTIMATE` 15-yr by special roll order) and Nano-Ceramic Solar Heat Rejection Window Tint Films (`Solar Armor VUE`, `Solar Armor APEX`, `Solar Armor ICONIC`).
- **Key Characteristics:** TPU paint protection films (VTEK describes PCDL- and PCL-based TPU) with a self-healing top layer; manufacturer NFC e-warranties of 5 to 15 years by film, honoured for film professionally installed by VTEK-authorised installers.
- **Target Channels:** Detailing studios, tint shops, luxury vehicle dealerships, and individual car owners seeking premium surface protection.

### Autotriz Nano Ceramic Coatings, PPF Solutions & Polishing Systems
- **Origin:** Germany / International
- **Product Range:** Professional-grade nano ceramic coatings (`3D Matrix Ultra`, `3D Matrix Hybrid`, `REVO +15`, `ION+ +15`, `V-9 3D Matrix 9H`), specialized interior coatings (`Leather & Vinyl`, `Fabric & Textile Guard`), PPF installation & aftercare (`PPF Gel` 4L/20L, `PPF Refresh` 1L), automotive compounds (`Heavy Cut 901`, `Extreme Cut 801`, `Power Cut 701`, `One Step Polish`, `Ultimate Polish 302`), and commercial wash chemicals (`Rich Foam Shampoo` 20L, `Hyper Wheel Cleaner` 20L).

### Briller Car Care
- **Origin:** Canada
- **Product Range:** Automotive wash chemicals, detailing sprays, tyre dressings, wheel cleaners, and surface degreasers formulated with All-in-One CA Tech™ for harsh GCC weather conditions in 20L workshop drums and retail formats.
- **Key Products:** Car Shampoo Wash & Wax (20L), Multi-Purpose Cleaner (20L), Quick Tyre Shine (20L), Crystal Clear Glass Cleaner (20L), Heavy Duty Degreaser (20L), Quick Dressing (20L), Alloy Rim Cleaner (20L), Tyre Foam.

### Grizzly & GrünesAuto
- **Product Range:** Grizzly Self-Healing TPU Paint Protection Film (7.5 mil, QAR 1,200/roll), Grizzly One Step Polish 3-in-1 (1L, QAR 115), Carnauba Paste Wax, Spray Wax, Rim Cleaner, Engine Cleaner, 20 kg Touchless Car Wash Powder; plus GrünesAuto 6-inch German-engineered foam polishing pads (DA & Rotary Step 1 Heavy Cut, Step 2 Medium Polish, Step 3 Finishing at QAR 30 each) and plush microfibre towels.

### ABK Proprietary Products
- **ABK Rejuvenate Plastic Restorer:** Made in France. Multi-surface exterior trim restorer restoring deep OEM satin-black finish to faded, sun-damaged bumpers, trims, and engine bays with 6+ months durability. Available in 60 ml (QAR 50), 250 ml (QAR 180), 350 ml (QAR 220), and 500 ml (QAR 280).
- **ABK Home & Car Fragrance Line:** Mashmom and Secret concentrated luxury scents (250 ml, QAR 70) formulated for Gulf interiors and majlis spaces.

### Insta Finish (USA), Getsun, Sitrett & Smart Car
- **Product Range:** Insta Finish Butter Wet Wax, Clean N Shine, Super All Purpose Cleaner (APC), Maxi Suds Cherry Shampoo; Sitrett MX5 Heavy-Duty Multi-Surface Degreaser; Getsun Scratch Remover, Spray Polish, Leather & Tyre Wax; Smart Car Tyre Foam; Detainer Sticker & Adhesive Remover.

## 3. Qatar Climate Adaptation & Detailing Challenges

Every chemical and film distributed by ABK is selected specifically to withstand the extreme environmental conditions of the Arabian Gulf:
1. **Extreme Ambient Heat (45°C–50°C+):** Cheap PVC/TPH films can turn brittle in this heat. TPU films such as VTEK Weather Armor carry a written manufacturer warranty of 5 to 15 years by film.
2. **Desert Sandstorm Abrasion:** Sand micro-particles act as an abrasive grit at highway speeds (120 km/h). VTEK self-healing top-coats absorb micro-swirls, self-repairing under ambient Doha sunlight.
3. **Hard Tap Water & Mineral Etching:** Doha desalinated tap water contains dissolved minerals (calcium/magnesium). Autotriz ceramic coatings provide hydrophobic contact angles (>110°), helping water slide off before droplets bake into mineral rings.
4. **Intense Solar UV Radiation:** High UV index causes clearcoat oxidation, plastic trim chalking, and interior leather shrinkage. VTEK Solar Armor window films block 99%+ UV and up to 95% infrared heat, while ABK Rejuvenate restores sun-faded exterior plastics.

6. ABK fitting guarantee for 12 months from handover (lifting, bubbles, edge failure). It does not cover accidents, stone impacts, improper washing or pressure-washing the film edges, repairs done elsewhere or paint defects recorded at drop-off.

- **Registered in VTEK's system.** Every job is registered on VTEK's NFC e-Warranty, which shows the film, the date and the installer. Check it with your plate and phone number. https://nfc.vtekfilms.com/verify
- **VTEK film warranty, 5–15 years.** VTEK covers film fitted by an authorised installer against manufacturing defects such as bubbling, cracking, peeling and fading. https://www.vtekfilms.com/warranty

How to check the VTEK e-warranty yourself:
1. Open nfc.vtekfilms.com/verify.
2. Enter your car's plate number and your phone number.
3. Choose Verify Coverage. VTEK's digital warranty shows the product installed, the installation date, the installer's details and the warranty terms and status.

Who fits the car:
- A VTEK-authorised installer in Doha, booked and managed by ABK. VTEK's warranty only covers film professionally installed by authorised installers, so that is the only kind of fitting we sell.
- The installer's details are recorded on your VTEK e-warranty, so you can see who fitted the film.
- Photos of the car at drop-off, an ABK inspection of the finish at handover, and your warranty registered before the car leaves.

If something goes wrong:
1. Message ABK on WhatsApp with photos of the problem.
2. We inspect it and arrange the repair with the installer. Covered fitting problems in the first 12 months are put right at no cost.
3. For a film defect we take the claim to VTEK. VTEK's terms start every claim with the original installer, and VTEK makes the final decision on whether it is a manufacturing defect.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (Store, Products & Wholesale)

### Q1: How long does paint protection film last?
Premium paint protection films like VTEK Weather Armor typically last 5–15 years under normal use, depending on the film grade, climate exposure and care. The self-healing top-coat regenerates light scratches with heat from the sun or warm water.

### Q2: Do you supply car care products wholesale to other shops in Qatar?
Yes. ABK supplies wholesale VTEK PPF, Autotriz and Briller products to detailing shops, body shops and car-wash businesses across Qatar and the GCC. Volume pricing is quoted per request on WhatsApp.

### Q3: Do your window films meet Qatar tint regulations?
Yes. We stock heat-rejecting window films in multiple VLT (visible light transmission) grades that meet Qatar's vehicle tint regulations. Tell us your vehicle and we will confirm the right grade before you buy.

### Q4: What is the difference between PPF and ceramic coating?
PPF is a thick urethane film that physically blocks rock chips, scratches and impacts. Ceramic coating is a thin chemical layer that adds gloss and water-repellency but does not stop physical damage. Many customers apply ceramic coating on top of PPF for both benefits.

### Q5: Where is the ABK store located in Doha?
ABK Trading & Service is at Showroom no. 2, Building 1306, Street 70, Zone 56, Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar. Open Saturday to Thursday, 10:00–13:00 and 16:00–22:00. Closed Friday.

### Q6: How much does paint protection film cost in Qatar?
Installed VTEK PPF from ABK starts at QAR 899 for a front-end kit, QAR 1,599 for a full front and QAR 3,999 for a full body, depending on car size and film. Film by the roll is quoted on WhatsApp.

### Q7: Which ceramic coating works best in Qatar's heat?
Ceramic coatings rated for high-UV exposure (9H hardness, hydrophobic top-coat) perform best in Qatar's climate. Autotriz and Briller systems we carry are formulated for Gulf summers and resist water-spotting from hard tap water common in Doha.

### Q8: Do you ship car care products from Qatar to UAE, Saudi Arabia or Kuwait?
Yes — wholesale orders ship across the GCC. Lead time and freight depend on order volume and destination. WhatsApp +974 30838355 with your country, products and quantities for a delivered-price quote.

### Q9: What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale car care products?
Minimum order quantities vary by brand. Autotriz and Briller can be ordered by the case. VTEK PPF rolls are sold per roll. Detailing accessories are flexible. WhatsApp the brands and SKUs you want and we'll send the wholesale price sheet.

### Q10: Is VTEK PPF covered by warranty?
Yes. Genuine VTEK (formerly Vertek) PPF carries a 5 to 15-year manufacturer warranty, depending on the film, against defects such as bubbling, cracking, peeling and fading when fitted by an authorised installer following VTEK's procedures. ABK is the authorised Qatar distributor and supplies the film with official warranty documentation.

### Q11: Can PPF be removed without damaging the paint?
Yes — quality PPF like VTEK Weather Armor is designed for clean removal by a trained technician using controlled heat. The original paint underneath is preserved, often in better condition than unprotected paint of the same age.

### Q12: Where can I buy car care products in Qatar?
ABK Trading and Service in Mesaimeer, Doha stocks a full range of car care products — car shampoos, polishing compounds, ceramic coatings, tyre shine, glass cleaners, paint protection film and more. Walk in Saturday to Thursday or order via WhatsApp at +974 30838355.

### Q13: What is the best car shampoo for hot climates like Qatar?
pH-balanced car shampoos that do not strip wax or coatings perform best in Gulf heat. Autotriz Rich Foam Shampoo and Briller Wash and Wax are formulated to clean safely without spotting even in direct sunlight. Both are available at ABK Trading in Doha.

### Q14: How often should I wash my car in Doha?
In Doha's dusty, humid climate most detailers recommend washing every 7 to 10 days. Cars with ceramic coating or PPF need less frequent washing because dust and water bead off the surface. Using a quality car shampoo prevents hard water spots common with Doha tap water.

### Q15: What car detailing products do professionals use in Doha?
Professional detailers in Doha typically use Autotriz cutting compounds and polishes for paint correction, Briller car shampoos for pre-wash, and Autotriz or Briller ceramic coatings for long-term protection. ABK Trading supplies these brands to workshops and individual detailers across Qatar.

### Q16: Can car polish remove scratches from my car?
Yes — polishing compounds like Autotriz Heavy Cut 901 remove sanding marks and deep swirls, while finishing polishes like Autotriz Ultimate Polish 302 restore a high-gloss, hologram-free finish. For best results, professional machine polishing is recommended. ABK stocks these compounds at our Mesaimeer store.

### Q17: Can I buy single car care bottles for personal use or is ABK wholesale only?
ABK serves both individual car owners and commercial businesses. You can purchase single bottles of car shampoos, waxes, plastic restorers, and accessories at our Mesaimeer store or order on WhatsApp with rapid Qatar delivery. Detailing studios and workshops receive tiered wholesale volume pricing.

### Q18: How does the WhatsApp Order Tray work?
The WhatsApp Order Tray lets you browse products, set quantities, and compile a single multi-item order or commercial quote request. When ready, tap 'Send Order via WhatsApp' to launch a pre-formatted message with item details, quantities, and direct links.

### PPF Q1: How much does PPF installation cost in Qatar, and can I get a full body under QAR 5,000?

### PPF Q2: Who installs the film?
A VTEK-authorised installer in Doha, booked and managed by ABK. VTEK's warranty only covers film professionally installed by authorised installers. ABK supplies the genuine film, confirms your slot, photographs the car at drop-off, inspects the finish at handover and stays your single point of contact. The installer's details are recorded on your VTEK e-warranty.

Check it in VTEK's own system. VTEK's own contact page also lists our Mesaimeer showroom as its Qatar contact. ABK supplies the film from its own stock, photographs the car at drop-off and inspects the finish before handover.

### PPF Q4: Which VTEK film should I choose?
Weather Armor PRO suits most daily drivers: gloss finish, 10 years VTEK warranty, full body from QAR 3,999. PRO PLUS is the step-up gloss grade (10 years VTEK warranty) from QAR 4,799; ask us on WhatsApp what it adds for your car. MATTE gives a satin finish (5 years warranty) from QAR 4,799, and PRISM changes the colour (5 years warranty) and is priced per car. ULTIMATE, VTEK's flagship gloss film with a 15 years warranty, is available by special roll order.

### PPF Q5: Is a full front enough, or should I get a full body?
A full front covers the panels that take stone chips on Qatar's highways — bonnet, front bumper, fenders, mirrors and headlights — from QAR 1,599 on a sedan. A full body (from QAR 3,999) adds the doors, sides, roof and rear against sand abrasion, parking scuffs and wash swirls, and suits a new or high-value car you plan to keep.

### PPF Q6: Can I protect only some panels?
Yes. Pick "Choose parts" in the quote builder and tap the panels you want. The estimate updates as you go, starts at QAR 500 and never exceeds the full-body price for your car; we confirm the final price on WhatsApp.

### PPF Q7: How long does PPF installation take?
Typically the same day for a front-end kit, one day for a full front and two to three days for a full body, including curing time. We confirm the exact time with your slot.

### PPF Q8: How do I book PPF installation in Doha?
Tap "Get my instant quote" on this page, choose your car, coverage and film, and send the quote on WhatsApp. We confirm film stock, your slot and the final price during opening hours (Saturday to Thursday, 10:00 – 13:00 and 16:00 – 22:00). You pay in full by bank transfer or cash once the slot is confirmed, drop the car at the confirmed Doha location, and collect it after our handover inspection.

### PPF Q9: How do I pay, and can I cancel?
Once we confirm your slot you pay in full by bank transfer or cash. Cancel up to 48 hours before for a full refund; one reschedule is free.

### PPF Q10: What is the difference between the film warranty and the workmanship cover?
VTEK's film warranty covers the film itself against manufacturing defects such as bubbling, cracking, peeling and fading when an authorised installer fits it: PRO 10 years, PRO PLUS 10 years, MATTE and PRISM 5 years, and ULTIMATE 15 years (special roll order), as listed on vtekfilms.com/warranty. ABK's separate 12-month fitting guarantee covers the installation itself: edge lifting, bubbles or misalignment. It does not cover accidents, stone impacts, improper washing or pressure-washing the film edges, repairs done elsewhere or paint defects recorded at drop-off.

### PPF Q11: What if something goes wrong with the film or the fitting?
Message ABK on WhatsApp with photos. We inspect it and arrange the repair with the installer; covered fitting problems in the first 12 months are put right at no cost. For a film defect we take the claim to VTEK: its terms start every claim with the original installer, and VTEK makes the final decision on whether it is a manufacturing defect. VTEK also says its warranty can be transferred to a new owner with proof of purchase.

### PPF Q12: My car already has old PPF or a wrap. Can you still do it?
Yes. Tell us in the booking form; old film or wrap has to be removed first, and we include that in the confirmed price.

### PPF Q13: Can I fit PPF on a new car, or after a repaint?
Yes on a new car: VTEK says factory paint is fully cured when the car leaves the assembly line. After a respray VTEK recommends waiting about 2 months so the paint cures fully. Tell us in the booking form if the car was recently repainted.

### PPF Q14: Can PPF handle sandstorms and gravel on Qatar highways (Al Shamal and Salwa roads)?
PPF takes the hit instead of your paint. The transparent polyurethane layer absorbs stone chips and sand abrasion on roads like Al Shamal and Salwa, and its self-healing top layer closes light swirl marks from washing and dust. No film makes paint chip-proof, and VTEK notes that a scratch cutting all the way through the self-healing layer will not heal, which is why highway drivers should cover at least the full front.

### PPF Q15: How soon after PPF installation can I wash my car in Doha?
VTEK says to wait about 7 days before an automatic car wash or pressure washing so the film dries completely, and to keep the pressure jet away from the film edges. Use ordinary car shampoo or detail spray, and avoid wax and sealants on the film. VTEK recommends a PPF-specific coating, such as Autotriz PPF & Vinyl Wrap Coating, once a year.

### PPF Q16: Can PPF damage my paint when it is removed?
VTEK says it is highly unlikely, because factory paint bonds to the panel far more strongly than the film bonds to the paint. It still recommends having the film removed by a professional following its published guidelines, and old film on a car we are fitting is removed first.

### PPF Q17: What is the difference between genuine TPU and cheap PVC or TPH film?
Paint protection film should be made of TPU, thermoplastic polyurethane. VTEK Weather Armor is TPU-based, and VTEK backs it with a written 5 to 15 year warranty that you can look up in its e-warranty system. Be careful with films sold without a named manufacturer, a stated warranty term or a way to verify the installation, and ask any installer which film they use and where its warranty can be checked.

### PPF Q18: Can I combine PPF installation with ceramic coating?
Yes, but the order matters. VTEK advises against putting a wax, sealant or ceramic coating on the paint before the film, because it lowers the film's grip on the paint; any coating goes on after installation. On top of the film VTEK recommends only a PPF-specific coating such as Autotriz PPF & Vinyl Wrap Coating, because most nano ceramic coatings are silicone-based and do not bond well to the film.

### PPF Q19: Where in Doha is the PPF installation performed?
At a VTEK-authorised installer's centre in Doha, chosen by ABK. We confirm the location and drop-off instructions with your appointment slot. It is convenient from Mesaimeer, Al Rayyan, Lusail, West Bay, The Pearl, Al Wakrah and Al Khor.

### PPF Q20: I'm not sure which category my car falls under. How can I get an exact offer?
Type your car's make and model in the quote builder search bar to automatically see its category and instant price. If your vehicle isn't listed or you prefer a tailored quote, select 'Not sure? Get a Custom Offer' and enter your make and model — our team will confirm the exact offer on WhatsApp.
